scope: Hash-bound cost, latency, retry and structural reliability evaluation for tone runs
validated_behaviors: Every test case has a contiguous bounded attempt sequence beginning with primary.
Failed, retry and repair attempts remain in latency, token and cost denominators.
Unknown provider usage is never treated as zero and blocks admission.
First-attempt and final structural validity are reported separately.
Cost per 1000 input tokens, cost per 100 cases and nearest-rank p50/p95 latency are checked against a named policy.
Operational admission remains coupled to publishable blind-test gold and complete predictions.
known_boundary: This evaluates frozen attempt records only. It does not call a provider, approve a budget owner, cover the security split, enable tone publication or deploy production.
